mark_breakdown.desc: Correct method for mean and median for n = 14

subparts.solution: $\text{mean} = \frac{10613 + 5453 + \dots + 8888}{14} = \frac{66866}{14} \approx 4776\text{ steps}$. As $n = 14$, $\frac{n+1}{2} = 7.5$. So the median is the average of the 7th and 8th data values. The ordered data set is: $261, 1468, 2939, 3417, 3504, 3526, 4093, 4253, 5453, 5570, 6321, 6560, 8888, 10613$. $\therefore \text{median} = \frac{4093 + 4253}{2} = 4173\text{ steps}$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Sum all 14 data points and divide by 14 for the mean. For the median, average the 7th and 8th ordered values.
step_by_step: Order values and find 7th (4093) and 8th (4253) values.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Calculating the median without first sorting the step counts.

mark_breakdown.desc: Selecting median and stating it is not affected by extreme values

subparts.solution: The median is not affected by extreme values. So, the median is the most suitable to determine the typical number of steps taken by Janice each day.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: When data contains extreme values (outliers such as 261 or 10613), the median is a more robust and representative measure of central tendency than the mean.
step_by_step: Check the data for extreme values (e.g. 261 is very low, 10613 is very high).
Recognize that extreme values pull the mean away from the typical centre.
Choose the median as the suitable measure.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Choosing the mean by default without considering skewness or extreme values.
